common_start: To give controls and Bayesian candidates identical investable histories, use the first date on which every posterior has at least126 mature origin dates. Initial signal/label warm-up stays outside all strategy accounts. Actual common date is recorded in data_manifest.json, not assumed to be2009-01-09.
rank: Rank is among data-qualified names before anomaly quarantine. Quarantine blocks new purchases/training observations, not automatic sales of incumbents. Membership/near/rank criteria still apply. Unknown current ranks due missing/untradable data lock existing quantity unless membership exit is already known.
H: Forecast5 or20 sessions is distinct from the5-session review cadence and unconstrained actual holding time.
probability_cost: Entry probability threshold uses first-order roundtrip cost2*(commission+execution)+sale_tax at signal date. Actual account uses exact separate monetary costs at execution dates; future tax law changes are not forecast alpha.
rolling: When daily selector has no positive candidate, disallow new names but continue existing-position management with last active Bayesian model. All coefficients still update daily.
band: Weight band is imposed after the convex optimum. Re-evaluate optional utility improvement after imposing band and suppress optional trades if it falls below0.5bp NAV. Mandated membership/signal/posterior exits and cap reductions can still execute. Solver gap certifies pre-band optimization, not final banded global optimality.
